algorithm.name: POSITIVE_NESTED_COMPOSITE_SIMPSON_PRODUCT_LOGSUM
algorithm.levels: all integers first_level..last_level, no early stop
algorithm.cache: canonical common-denominator dyadic node; complete five-model returns only
algorithm.alternative: adaptive five-output cubature with explicit qualified service; not selected or implemented

prior.nuisance_measure: same common kappa d_eta; log kappa omitted, existing prefactors retained

plan.callback_cap: explicit integer1..300000, must cover complete finest grid before any call
plan.refinement_target: positive finite absolute log difference; diagnostic only
plan.limits_scope: schema caps only; not execution budget, wall/CPU/RAM or a campaign

callback.counts_measured_here: wrapper callback entries and complete validated returns
callback.background_count_scope: Original successful execution receipt1/1; NEW_EXECUTION has one new call, VERIFIED_DURABLE_CACHE has zero new calls. Counts declared and not independently instrumented by pure integrator.
callback.canonical_conditional_digest: JSON sort_keys/ensure_ascii/separators=(',',':')/no newline. Only models/<model>/log_conditional_integral negative infinity encodes as {'$float':'-inf'}. Hash SHA256.
callback.durable_idempotence: Controller/callback must atomically reserve and persist unit/node before science; no failed/pending/uncertain node repeat across processes
callback.loaded_object_identity: trusted caller verifies actual source/runtime; metadata names/hashes alone are not authentication

checks.theta: exact three-element theta passed in descriptor, all model evaluations joint
checks.context: same consumer admission, output measure, rank63..283, eta63 and complete normalization across nodes
checks.priors: base theta uniform not already applied/integrated by callback
checks.background: same packet digest cannot be reused at distinct theta
checks.pointwise_status: finite engineering/flat-extra or explicit support-complement zero only

failures.in_process: single-use PREPARED->RUNNING->COMPLETED or FAILED_TERMINAL; attempted before callback, complete cache only
failures.interprocess: not guaranteed by pure object; required in controller/callback
failures.scientific_or_metadata_error: abort whole collection; no partial evidence/renormalization
failures.sampled_all_zero: continue fixed refinements; if finest remains all-zero for any model, fail without inferring global zero mass
failures.underflow: count terms/inner nodes; not certificate of missed mass

output.refinement_indicator: heuristic only, not global convergence/certified error
output.certification: UNBOUNDED_THEORY_ERROR; inner and theoretical errors not bounded by outer gaps

resources.supervision: future controller owns runtime/RAM/cleanup; pure module makes no OS cap claim

preserved: f820 services prepared separately by manager

global_configuration.required_before_callbacks: Frozen configuration containing full finite grid theta/point IDs; one common assembly admission binds config/runtime and consumer prediction_admission_sha256 binds assembly.
global_configuration.actual_worker: prediction_worker selects point_id in config['points']; no motor change required.
global_configuration.no_reuse_of_single_point_admission: c435 remains consumed; its single-point config/admission cannot stand for a new full grid.
global_configuration.checks_here: plan/descriptor/receipt hashes equal; actual content/coverage/custody verified by controller
global_configuration.durable_cache: May share exactly qualified same-theta background across compatible scenarios; never reuse likelihood across different C/admission.
